articles.summary: Associated Bank announced completion of a $16,500,000 loan towards the $22,000,000 total acquisition price of Eleven5 Lake Apartments at 115 Lake Street in Libertyville, Illinois.
articles.title: Associated Bank contributes $16.5M for Libertyville, Illinois, mixed-use apartment acquisition

articles.summary: Associated Banc-Corp (NYSE: ASB) ("Associated" or "Company") today reported net income available to common equity ("earnings") of $144 million, or $0.76 per common share, for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
articles.title: Associated Banc-Corp Reports Third Quarter 2026 Earnings of $0.76 Per Common Share, or $0.81 Per Common Share¹ Excluding Nonrecurring Items Recognized During the Quarter
